jsonld.description: Process serving, court services and corporate searches for law firms across Vancouver and the Lower Mainland.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can documents be served?

acceptedAnswer.text: Service is typically attempted within 24 hours of receiving your documents and instructions. Rush requests are prioritized on receipt.

mainEntity.name: What proof of service do I receive?

acceptedAnswer.text: You'll receive a sworn Affidavit of Service detailing when and where service occurred, the person served, and the documents served. Attempt notes are also maintained where applicable.

mainEntity.name: What happens if the recipient evades service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attempts may be made at different times and on different days. If the recipient appears to be evading service or the address appears incorrect, you'll be notified promptly with a record of the attempts made.

mainEntity.name: Do you serve court documents from outside BC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ServePoint accepts documents issued by courts in other Canadian provinces and by US courts for service in Vancouver and the Lower Mainland. Proof of service is prepared according to the requirements provided by the instructing firm.

mainEntity.name: Can you confirm a company's registered office before service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A BC corporate search can confirm the company's registered office and other available corporate information before service, helping avoid attempts at outdated addresses.
Flat rates are available by service type, with preferred pricing available for law firms and high-volume clients. Any additional charges are confirmed before service is attempted.
